exclude: zero page and pages 2 and 3: the game's variables, every byte of them written by its code (the start-up code that ran at $0334 is gone once play begins); the stack page is the platform's own exclusion
four vectors the scroll stages and the panel interrupt rewrite every frame, kept in the place of panel character $E3, which the panel never shows
the unused end of the panel's screen and its sprite pointers, which the panel never uses: nothing reads them
the play screen at $C800 and the hidden rows 21 to 24 under it, where the object routines keep their variables: drawn and written as the game runs
the sprite pointers of the screen at $C800, written by the multiplexer
the second play screen at $CC00 and its hidden rows: drawn and written as the game runs
the sprite pointers of the screen at $CC00, written by the multiplexer

work bytes at the top of memory: the beam-in's spark sprite at $FF80, the sound effects' voice state at $FFC0, the hero's explosion and lives at $FFD8-$FFFD, and the interrupt vectors, all written by the code; $FF00-$FF7F is never read
include: the hero's sprites in the RAM under the I/O area, which only the video chip reads
